treatment_records.name: Azathioprine
treatment_records.reason_stopped: Joint pain and rashes developed, leading to lupus diagnosis.

evidence_notes: Diagnosed six years ago after second child. Also has postpartum anxiety and lupus. Started mesalamine while breastfeeding, then azathioprine. Joint pain and rashes led to lupus diagnosis. Started Humira two years ago, helps both conditions moderately (60%). Difficulty managing motherhood, marriage strained due to husband's lack of understanding. Works part-time freelance. Financial stress. Considering changing biologics as Humira losing effectiveness.
